findings.text: follow-on: catching all MachineMapError values and marking the module skipped treats duplicate or malformed bundles as absent; reintroducing jt-60sa to the public descriptor beside the private bundle would hide the regression rather than fail a test.
follow-on: the moved real-data test copies the engine test's STANDIN_WRAPPER and three local-extractor helpers while the engine retains them, creating two owners for the same test fixture.
follow-on: Ruff reformats unrelated assertions throughout the file inside the map move, which makes the intended path change harder to audit.

item_verdicts.diff: read commits 2d147887, c1233fd0, b4c50bbc and a78e3a36 against c255d3c3; the first removes public maps, the middle commits redirect readers and guards, and the last adds only the one-line evidence anchor.

item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md names four commits, all 19 changed paths, complete base and head arms and their logs; I parsed 54 base FAILED/ERROR ids and zero head ids directly from those logs, matching the manifest and yielding zero added ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:68-94 and manifest.md orientation_write_paths declare the fence; all 19 paths in git diff c255d3c3..a78e3a36 match manifest.md changed_paths and fall inside it.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log proves removing the availability skip yields six failures, but tests/data/test_jt60sa_machine_map.py:30 catches every MachineMapError, so a duplicated or invalid bundle becomes a skip and the tests do not guard that regression.

justifications.fit: scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py:1105 uses the established load_packaged_signal_map resolver and imas_ambix/data/bundle.py:18 keeps the existing eddb_cache role; the copied test fixture and reflow reduce fit slightly.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/data/bundle.json:4 retains only mast and diii-d, and git ls-tree at a78e3a36 lists no JT-60SA map path while scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py:1105 loads its PF map by bundle name.
justifications.reuse: tests/data/test_eddb_local_transport.py:38-97 duplicates the stand-in wrapper and helper capability still owned by packages/imas-alambic/tests/test_eddb_local_transport.py:38-97, with 98% similarity across the 1.8 kB helper block.
justifications.scope_discipline: all 19 changed paths are fenced, but tests/data/test_selene_deck.py:180 and scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py:1127 include unrelated Ruff reflow beside the map-path edits.
